### 🚪 Join a match already in progress
- A game no longer shuts its doors when it starts. Turn up five minutes late and you walk straight in — no waiting for the round to end.
- You arrive on your team's side of the map with the round's loadout and the usual spawn protection, and you see the live score, the clock, the flags and the dog tags on the floor exactly as everyone else does.
- The game browser marks rooms with a match running, so you know what you are walking into before you click.

### 🪟 Breakable windows
- Windows can now be glazed, and the glass breaks when you shoot it.
- The pane comes apart into real shards that tumble, fall and land — cracks radiating from the hole you just put through it.
- Glass stops nothing: a round goes through the window, takes the pane and still hits whoever is standing behind it. A shotgun through one window is one shatter.
- Map makers pick per window wall whether it has glass in it; every window built so far stays the open frame it was.

### ⌨️ The tab stops closing itself
- Crouch is Ctrl, so crouch-walking was Ctrl+W — and the browser closed the game. It doesn't any more: while you are playing, the browser's own tab shortcuts are taken away.
- Where that isn't possible, an accidental Ctrl+W or F5 asks you to confirm instead of dropping the session.
- Fixed the fullscreen switch in the settings fighting F11 — clicking "Windowed" after leaving fullscreen with F11 used to put you back into it.
